scope: Bolivia medical discovery — Universidad Mayor de San Andrés Faculty of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: UMSA's Medicine programme page sets out a curriculum spanning basic, pre-clinical and clinical cycles, with fifth-year subjects including paediatrics, gynaecology and obstetrics.

UMSA describes its rotating internship as part of the Medicine plan and a graduation modality; it lasts one calendar year and includes Medicine, Surgery, Paediatrics, Gynaecology-Obstetrics, and Public Health and Social Medicine rotations.
UMSA reported that 334 fifth-year Medicine students selected hospitals for the 2026 rotating internship across 17 hospitals.
